overlay.pvp-overlay.title: PvP Overlay
tooltip.pvp-overlay.taken: Shows the distance from the attacker to your hitbox when you receive a hit. Due to lag, server corrections, or delayed packets, values above vanilla reach can appear. This does not automatically mean the other person is cheating.
tooltip.pvp-overlay.force_main_hand: Other players can choose their own main hand. This option renders other players according to your selected setting, regardless of what they selected. LEFT renders left, RIGHT renders right. OFF does not interfere with rendering, so Minecraft's default behaviour stays active and you see the main hand the other person selected.
screen.pvp-overlay.config.title: PvP Overlay Config
screen.pvp-overlay.position.title: Edit PvP Overlay Layout
screen.pvp-overlay.position.instructions: Drag groups with the left mouse button. Drag groups onto each other to group them. Use Undo to revert the last action.
screen.pvp-overlay.group_settings.title: Group Settings
screen.pvp-overlay.group_settings.descri: Configure this overlay group's appearance and behaviour.
